description: Cs₂Na(C₂N₃)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent N atoms. There are three shorter (3.28 Å) and three longer (3.43 Å) Cs-N bond lengths. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.52 Å. C is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.18 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-N bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent C atoms.
